data.body: Reopened after smoke test on sandbox PR #262 (CI run 26253734117) FAILED bug 9788 assertion: 'no DSO-Review-Cycle PR comments posted — bug 9788 regression — cycle marker writer or parser regressed'. Bug 8a77 fix shipped via PR #252 and verified, but PR #262's CI did not post any DSO-Review-Cycle marker comments — meaning cycle_dispatcher / cycle marker writer is not emitting them. Either the prior fix (PR #257/258) didn't fully address this or there's a separate regression.
